[Evolution formulas are dimension-independent] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0187 1. Remark 6.4\group evolution-of-curvature-under-the-ricci-flow

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, the curvature evolution formulas in this section hold in every dimension $n \ge 2$.
